source_text: Reports from affected communities describe these acts as violent rituals using non-sterile tools, leading to infections and trauma, distinct from voluntary practices; ISIS justified them via fatwas emphasizing male genital modification for religious conformity, affecting hundreds in Christian enclaves before territorial losses in 2017.
